The page is live at [http://localhost:64848/live.html](http://localhost:64848/live.html). Here's what it does:

**Account section** — stat tiles showing your cash ($17.38), equity, unrealised and realised PnL (you have no open positions currently)

**Positions table** — shows "No open positions" (empty right now); will populate live when you trade

**Market cards** — 6 cards for NVDA, AAPL, GLD in both spot and perp, showing last price, 24h change/high/low/volume, and for perps: mark price, oracle price, funding rate, and open interest. Cards flash blue on each update.

**NVDA 1% alert** — tracks the NVDA perp price from when the page loaded. When it moves 1% in either direction:
- A red banner slides down from the top
- A browser notification fires (it asked for permission on load)
- An 880Hz beep plays
- Clicking the banner dismisses it and resets the reference price

**WebSocket** — connects to `wss://staging-rpc.podtestnet.dev`, subscribes to `pod_markets` (all 6 orderbooks) and `pod_positions` (your account), seeded with `since` from REST so the first snapshot arrives immediately. Auto-reconnects on disconnect.

**Event log** at the bottom shows every market tick, subscription event, and alert.

The file is at [live.html](file:///Users/sabpap/Workspace/Clients/Laurium/pod-ai-variants/1-raw/live.html) [📁](file:///Users/sabpap/Workspace/Clients/Laurium/pod-ai-variants/1-raw/).
